style.prompt_contract: Vertical 9:16 flat 2D storytime horror, icon-like. Solid flat colour fills with at most two tone values per surface, clean edges with bold uneven black outlines, low-key night-horror lighting: one or two small emitting fixtures, cool dim slate walls clearly lighter than the navy seats, and 60 to 75 percent of each frame held in flat near-black shadow shapes with a heavy flat vignette. Palette: near-black navy, bone white and one muted teal, with flat amber restaurant accents. All clothing is near-black navy, bone white or one muted teal. All hair is one solid black silhouette. Faces show only two solid black dot eyes and one short mouth line. Hands are flat simplified human hands with four straight finger blocks and one thumb, solid fill, no nails and no drawn finger joints. Full bodies use adult 1:6 proportions with flat segmented shoulders, elbows, hips and knees. Backgrounds keep layered flat depth and one-point perspective. The number of visible figures stays fixed from the first frame to the last.

restaurant.light: flat uniform colour fill with amber as one flat tint

aircraft_forward.geometry: narrow-body cabin, single aisle running front(near)->tail(far); exactly rows 27 and 28 visible, one seat per side in each row (1+1, four seats total); oval windows on BOTH sides; front galley/cockpit door at the near end
aircraft_forward.objects: empty seats only; overhead bins closed; one uninterrupted cabin aisle
aircraft_forward.light: cool white ceiling strips, city lights through the windows, faint teal aisle floor path

seat_27a.geometry: one dark night passenger cabin with exactly rows 27 and 28, one seat per side in each row, seat 27A beside one solid oval window and one thin ceiling strip
seat_27a.objects: one seated navy-clad passenger in 27A, three generic passengers in the other seats, and one flat phone screen resting on the lap
seat_27a.light: low-key night-horror light: one or two small emitting fixtures, cool dim slate walls clearly lighter than the navy seats, 60 to 75 percent of the frame held in flat near-black shadow shapes and a heavy flat vignette

aisle.geometry: same narrow-body aisle, continuous with seat_27a; rows 27->28 toward the tail, one seat per side in each row; the far dark end is the rear; row 28 is the last row before the lavatory

lavatory.light: cold teal inside the lavatory; one white sliver from the lit cabin through the door gap
